method: Read final existing XML/logs/artifacts only. This collection ran no tests, Gradle builds, artifact checker or device operations.
supersedes: Previous INTERIM_SNAPSHOT_NOT_FINAL collection with 329 JVM cases. Historical public excerpt files remain, labeled superseded in software-logs/README.md.
limitations: This is software validation evidence. It does not assert successful cloud requests, emulator acceptance, physical dual-screen control, Citra game completion, microphone/voice quality or hardware input reconstruction. Consult separate evidence for those scopes.
Gradle reused :core:test and :input-lab:testDebugUnitTest as UP-TO-DATE; their actual retained XML results are included with original hashes/mtimes. This was not a clean rerun of every JVM case.

AssembleDebugAndroidTest compiles instrumentation tests; it does not execute them. Background Runtime, dual-screen controls and PickerResultLifecycleTest execution must be established by separate device test evidence.
Unsigned release artifacts were built and checked; this does not prove release signing, distribution or installation.

Collection is per-file, not an atomic repository snapshot. Source hashes describe files at collection time; APK hashes identify exact built artifacts, not packages claimed to have run all device checks.
